basic_info.description: Nestled high on the hill in the serene neighborhood of Westwood Heights, 154 Burlwood offers a unique sanctuary with breathtaking panoramic views stretching from the Bay to the Ocean. This charming three-bedroom, two-bathroom home has been thoughtfully upgraded to blend modern convenience with timeless elegance. As you step inside, you'll be greeted by freshly painted walls, refinished floors, and new light fixtures that illuminate the space beautifully. The main floor features two cozy bedrooms facing the quiet street, while the back of the home opens up to a spacious great room. Here, a combination living and dining area, complete with a decorative fireplace, invites you to relax and take in the majestic views from the expansive living room window. Descend to the bottom floor, where a private bedroom with an en suite bathroom offers the same stunning vistas. Just off the garage, a spacious deck awaits, overlooking a backyard that is ready to be transformed into your personal oasis. With ample room to expand the living space in the garage, this home offers endless possibilities. Situated on a tranquil street, 154 Burlwood is truly a haven in Westwood Heights, promising a lifestyle of peace and potential.
